name: tristan-shadowdancer-redirect-usable-while-rested
notes: Tristan, Shadowdancer (he6kd7hocc): "Remove two preparation counters from Tristan: Change the target of an attack that targets Tristan to a phantasia ally you control." The printed cost has no [REST], so an already RESTED Tristan (patched to Status 1 with exactly 2 preparation counters) must still be offered Redirect and may use it, and it must neither wake nor re-rest him. Companion of tristan-shadowdancer-redirect-does-not-rest-champion (the fix for the implicit-REST bug: he6kd7hocc added to the $skipAutoRest list in Custom/GameLogic.php DoActivatedAbility()). Same real attack flow: the opportunity window offers "myField-0@Activate-0@Redirect", the Shadow is chosen, the Dungeon Guide (1 POWER) hits the Shadow. Per-step dump confirms Tristan is Status 1 at every step and the window really opened at step 3.

rulesClauses: Remove two preparation counters from Tristan: Change the target of an attack that targets Tristan to a phantasia ally you control. (no [REST] in the cost: usable while rested)
